# iliad-105 — renderings chosen for 16.569–675 (to be copied into conventions.md)

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| ἱκέτευσε (16.574, ἐς Πηλῆ’ ἱκέτευσε) | "supplicated" | "made his plea as a suppliant" | "begged"; follows the table's ἱκετεύω (7.292) |
| Ἴλιον εἰς εὔπωλον (16.576) | "to Ilios of the fine foals" | "to Ilios of the fine foals" | "Ilium"; follows the published odyssey-066 line, as the table's later rows do (8.561, 5.204); the table's own row for 5.551 gives "Ilium" in `l`, which the same row's note contradicts, and needs correcting |
| ἁπτόμενον νέκυος (16.577) | "laid hold of the dead man" | "laid hold of the dead man" | "touching the corpse", "grasping"; νέκυς "dead man" (as νέκυι κατατεθνηῶτι, 16.526), νεκρός "corpse" |
| χερμαδίῳ (16.577, 16.587) | "with a rock" | "with a rock" | "stone" (kept for λᾶας, λίθος), "boulder"; follows χερμάδιον "rock" (5.302) |
| ἴθυσεν διὰ προμάχων (16.582) | "charged through the front-fighters" | "charged through the foremost fighters" | "rushed" (kept for σεύω), "made straight for", "darted"; ἰθύω "charge straight"; ἰθύς "straight" |
| ἴρηξ · κολοιοί · ψῆρες (16.582–583) | "hawk" · "jackdaws" · "starlings" | same | "falcon" (κίρκος), "crows", "sparrows"; ψάρ is the usual "starling" |
| ἐξόπιθεν · κατέκυψε · ἐνισκίμφθη · οὐρίαχος · πελεμίχθη (16.611–612) | "from behind" · "bent down" · "was fixed" · "butt-end" · "was shaken" | "behind him" · "bent forward" · "was fixed in the ground" · "butt-end" · "shook" | "stooped", "ducked"; "butt-spike", "ferrule", "spike alone", "tip"; "stuck quivering" for ἐνισκίμφθη, "quivered" (κραδαίνω, 16.614, is "quivering"); οὐρίαχος keeps the published iliad-081 "butt-end" (13.443) and πελεμίζω "shake" (4.535, 16.108) |
| ἀφίει μένος (16.613) | "was letting go the might" | "let the might go" | follows the published iliad-081 line (13.444) word for word; whose might is not said and both layers leave it open (μένος is "might" throughout this part, as in the table, 2.387) |
| ὀρχηστής (16.617) | "dancer" | "dancer" | "tumbler", "acrobat"; ὀρχηστύς "dancing" |
| τάχα κέν … κατέπαυσε διαμπερές (16.617–618) | "very soon … would have stopped completely" | "would very soon have put a stop to you for good" | "put an end to your dancing" (supplies a word), "right through" (the table's διαμπερές, 5.284; here it would be only the body); τάχα κεν "very soon" (11.654) |
| τὸν δ’ αὖ Μηριόνης δουρικλυτὸς ἀντίον ηὔδα (16.619, whole-line reply-formula) | "To him in turn Meriones, famed-for-the-spear, spoke, face to face:" | "Then Meriones, famed for his spear, spoke to him in turn, face to face:" | the table's Peiraeus row (15.544) with the name changed; "answered" (reserved for ἀμείβομαι) |
| σβέσσαι μένος (16.621) | "to quench the might" | "to quench the might" | "put out the strength", "break the spirit"; σβέννυμι "quench", μένος "might" (the table, 2.387; "strength" is kept for κράτος and σθένος) |
| θνητὸς … τέτυξαι (16.622) | "mortal … you have been made" | "you too are mortal" | "doomed to die" (καταθνητός "liable to death", 5.402), "a mortal like me" |
| εὖχος ἐμοὶ δοίης, ψυχὴν δ’ Ἄϊδι κλυτοπώλῳ (16.625) | "a boast to me you would give, and your soul to Hades of the famous horses" | "you would give me the triumph, and your soul to Hades of the famous horses" | the table's 5.654 row (εὖχος "a boast" in `l`, "the triumph" in `i`), unchanged |
| ὣς φάτο, τὸν δ’ ἐνένιπε Μενοιτίου ἄλκιμος υἱός (16.626, whole-line speech introduction) | "So he spoke, and him rebuked Menoetius’ sturdy son:" | "So he spoke, and Menoetius’ sturdy son rebuked him:" | "reproved", "scolded", "valiant"; the table's ἐνίπτω "rebuke" (3.438) and Μενοιτίου ἄλκιμος υἱός "Menoetius’ sturdy son" (11.605) |
| ὦ πέπον (16.628) | "O good one" | "my good fellow" (+ note: sense of πέπον not known) | follows the table's ὢ πέπον (13.154) |
| ὀνειδείοις ἐπέεσσι (16.628) | "by reproachful words" | "for words of reproach" | "insults" (the table's ὀνείδεα "reproaches", 3.242, is the noun), "taunts", "abuse" |
| πάρος τινὰ γαῖα καθέξει (16.629) | "before that, someone the earth will hold down" | "before that, the earth will hold someone fast" | "will cover", "will bury" (the burial is a separate thing), "some of us" (adds a plural); κατέχω "hold down" (3.419), "hold fast" (2.233) |
| ἐν γὰρ χερσὶ τέλος πολέμου, ἐπέων δ’ ἐνὶ βουλῇ (16.630) | "for in hands the end of war, and of words in counsel" | "for the end of war is in the hands, and that of words in counsel" | "outcome", "decision"; τέλος "end" (3.290), βουλή "counsel" as in the table's "plan" for the god's βουλή, here of an assembly |
| μῦθον ὀφέλλειν (16.631) | "increase talk" | "increase talk" | "add to our words", "multiply words", "exalt"; ὀφέλλω "increase" (1.510) |
| ὀρυμαγδός · δρυτόμοι (16.633) | "a din" · "woodcutting men" | "the din" · "woodcutters" | "uproar", "clamour"; ὀρυμαγδός "din" (2.810) |
| ἀκουή (16.634, ἕκαθεν δέ τε γίγνετ’ ἀκουή) | "from afar the hearing comes about" | "is heard from far off" | "report", "the sound reaches"; ἀκουή "hearing" (the table's 14.179 "news" is the sense with μετά) |
| ῥινοῦ · βοῶν εὐποιητάων (16.636) | "of hide and of oxen, well-made" | "hide and well-made ox-hides" (+ note: shields named by their covering) | "shields of ox-hide" (names the thing), "well-made bucklers"; follows the table's ῥινοί "hide shields" (4.447) |
| φράδμων (16.638) | "shrewd" | "shrewd" | "wise", "knowing", "careful"; φράζω "point out, take thought" |
| εἴλυτο … διαμπερὲς ἐς πόδας ἄκρους (16.640) | "was wrapped … right through to the tips of his feet" | "was wrapped … right down to the tips of his feet" | "covered", "clothed"; διαμπερές "right through" |
| περιγλαγέας … πέλλας (16.642) | "pails brimming with milk" | "pails brimming with milk" | "milk-full" (adds a hyphen to a rare word), "milk-pails" alone (loses περι-); γλάγος "milk" |
| βρομέωσι (16.642) | "buzz" | "buzz" | "hum", "swarm"; the table's "thronging" is for ὁμιλέω |
| ὁμίλεον (16.641, 16.644) | "kept thronging" · "kept thronging" | "kept thronging" · "thronged" | "kept company" (the table's ὁμιλέω of men, 1.261), "swarmed", "mingled" (5.85); ὁμιλέω "be in a crowd" |
| πολλὰ μάλ’ ἀμφὶ φόνῳ Πατρόκλου μερμηρίζων (16.647) | "much indeed about the slaying of Patroclus being in doubt" | "much in doubt about the killing of Patroclus" | "pondering", "debating" (the table reserves them); μερμηρίζω "be in doubt" (12.199) |
| ἀνάλκιδα θυμὸν ἐνῆκεν (16.656) | "a spirit without might he put" | "he put a spirit without might" | "a cowardly spirit", "fear"; follows ἀνάλκις "without might" (5.349) |
| γνῶ γὰρ Διὸς ἱρὰ τάλαντα (16.658) | "for he recognised the sacred scales of Zeus" | "for he recognised the sacred scales of Zeus" | "knew", "saw", "the holy scales"; ἱρός "sacred", τάλαντα "scales" (8.69, 12.433) |
| ἴφθιμοι Λύκιοι · βεβλαμμένον ἦτορ · νεκύων ἀγύρει (16.659–661) | "the mighty Lycians" · "harmed in heart" · "in a gathering of the dead" | "the mighty Lycians" · "harmed in the heart" · "in a throng of the dead" | "wounded" (βλάπτω is "hinder, harm", the table avoids "damaged", "disabled", "thwarted" for βλαφθέντα, 15.484), "pierced in the heart"; ἄγυρις "gathering, throng", νέκυς "dead man" |
| ἔριδα κρατερὴν ἐτάνυσσε Κρονίων (16.662) | "strong strife stretched the son of Cronus" | "the son of Cronus stretched out strong strife" | "drew taut", "stirred up"; follows μάχην ἐτάνυσσε Κρονίων (11.336) |
| ἔντεα χάλκεα μαρμαίροντα (16.663–664) | "the gear, bronze, sparkling" | "the sparkling bronze gear" | "armour" (kept for τεύχεα, 16.650 in the same part), "shining" (reserved for φαεινός); ἔντεα "gear" (3.339), μαρμαίρω "sparkle" (iliad-020, -074) |
| ἐλθὼν ἐκ βελέων (16.668) | "going out of the missiles" | "go out from the missiles" (+ note: direction not said) | "out of range", "from the fight"; each decides which way Apollo goes |
| πολλὸν ἀπὸ πρὸ φέρων (16.669) | "far away bearing" | "carry him far away" | "far from the fight", "far from here" (add a place) |
| λοῦσον · χρῖσον · ἕσσον (16.669–670) | "wash" · "anoint" · "put (about him)" | "wash" · "anoint" · "put … about him" | "bathe" (Ἥβη λοῦσεν, 5.905 is "bathed"; here the river-streams are the object), "dress" (5.905); ἀμβροσίη "ambrosia" |
| πομποῖσιν … κραιπνοῖσι (16.671) | "escorts, rushing ones" | "rushing escorts" | "swift"; κραιπνός "rushing" (iliad-029, -040) |
| Ὕπνῳ καὶ Θανάτῳ διδυμάοσιν (16.672) | "Sleep and Death, twins" | "Sleep and Death, the twins" | "twin brothers"; διδυμάων "twin" (5.548), Sleep and Death as at 16.454 |
| πίονι δήμῳ (16.673) | "the rich land" | "the rich land" | "fat" (kept for flocks and thigh-pieces), "fertile"; follows πίων "rich" (5.512) and δῆμος "land" |
| Ἑλλάδι οἰκία ναίων (16.595) | "in Hellas, inhabiting a home" | "lived in a home in Hellas" | "dwelling in a house" (οἰκία is plural), "Greece" (avoided in both layers); Ἑλλάς "Hellas" (2.683) |
| ὄλβῳ τε πλούτῳ τε μετέπρεπε Μυρμιδόνεσσι (16.596) | "in prosperity and wealth was conspicuous among the Myrmidons" | "was conspicuous among the Myrmidons for his prosperity and wealth" | "was richest", "stood out"; μεταπρέπω "be conspicuous among" (2.481) |
| πυκινὸν δ’ ἄχος ἔλλαβ’ Ἀχαιούς (16.599) | "and thick grief seized the Achaeans" | "and thick grief seized the Achaeans" | "heavy" (reserved for βριαρός), "dense", "bitter"; πυκινός "thick, close-packed" (the table's "solid", "shrewd" are for house and plan), ἄχος "grief", ἔλλαβε "seized" (5.83) |
| ἔνθ’ αὖ Μηριόνης Τρώων ἕλεν ἄνδρα κορυστήν (16.603) | "Then in turn Meriones of the Trojans took a helmeted warrior" | "Then in turn Meriones killed a helmeted warrior of the Trojans" | "armed man", "warrior" alone, "took" in `i`; κορυστής "helmeted warrior" as in the table (4.457, 13.201); ἕλεν "took" in `l`, "killed" in `i` |
| τὸν βάλ’ ὑπὸ γναθμοῖο καὶ οὔατος (16.606) | "Him he struck beneath the jaw and the ear" | "Meriones hit him beneath the jaw and the ear" | the published iliad-084 `l`; the published `i` names Paris, so only the subject differs |
